What changed in Dimorphos's orbit after DART
https://www.jpl.nasa.gov/news/nasa-study-asteroids-orbit-shape-changed-after-dart-impact/
Before impact, Dimorphos took 11 hours and 55 minutes to orbit the larger asteroid Didymos.
Immediately after impact, the period shortened by 32 minutes and 42 seconds, to 11 hours, 22 minutes and 37 seconds.
Over subsequent weeks Dimorphos lost more rocky material to space while its orbital period continued to shorten.
The period settled at 11 hours, 22 minutes and 3 seconds, 33 minutes and 15 seconds shorter than before impact.
The orbit was no longer circular after impact.

How NASA accounted for its Bennu sample
https://science.nasa.gov/blogs/osiris-rex/2024/02/15/nasa-announces-osiris-rex-bulk-sample-mass/
OSIRIS-REx returned material from asteroid Bennu to Earth on September 24, 2023.
The mission required at least 60 grams of asteroid material.
The team exceeded that requirement before completely opening the sampling head.
A final pour added 51.2 grams.
The completed inventory amounted to 121.6 grams.

Why the first three NIST post-quantum standards serve two distinct purposes
https://csrc.nist.gov/News/2024/postquantum-cryptography-fips-approved/
The Secretary of Commerce approved FIPS 203, 204 and 205 in August 2024.
FIPS 203 specifies ML-KEM to establish a shared secret between parties communicating over a public channel.
FIPS 204 specifies a module-lattice-based digital signature scheme.
FIPS 205 specifies a stateless hash-based digital signature scheme.
The schemes are designed to resist future quantum attacks.

Why the 1906 earthquake has different magnitude estimates
https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/events/1906calif/18april/magnitude.php
One team studied seismic recordings from 96 observatories and digitized and modeled usable data from 12.
That seismic analysis suggested a surface-wave magnitude of 7.7.
A USGS team instead re-evaluated geodetic measurements made before and after the earthquake.
The geodetic approach used ground deformation reflected in angles and distances between benchmarks and gave an estimate of 7.9.
Different methods of estimating earthquake size can disagree.

What age protection the Twenty-sixth Amendment added
https://www.archives.gov/founding-docs/amendments-11-27
Congress passed the amendment on March 23, 1971, and it was ratified on July 1, 1971.
The amendment bars both federal and state governments from denying or limiting US citizens' voting rights because of age when the citizens are at least 18.
Congress can enforce the amendment through appropriate legislation.

What cone-mode sparse checkout includes
https://git-scm.com/docs/git-sparse-checkout.html
Sparse checkout changes which tracked files are present in the working tree.
Cone mode selects directories and includes all files recursively under them.
It also includes files that are siblings of the selected directory or any ancestor directory.
